content.value: A prestressed concrete rectangular beam 500 mm by 750 mm has a simple span of (15) 7.30 m and is loaded by a uniform load of 45 KN/m including its own weight. The parabolically curved prestressing tendon is located as shown in figure below and produces an effective prestress of 1620 KN. Compute the extreme fiber stresses at mid span by the method of load balancing.
